description: Dangerous production action: add an IP/CIDR to the restrictive allowlist. Once active, allowlist mode blocks every IP except listed entries, so it is not a way to mark an IP trusted or suppress false positives (trusted IPs are a separate list). The server rejects the call unless allowlistDenyAllApproved is true.

allowlistDenyAllApproved.description: Confirms the deny-by-default behavior: once the allowlist has entries, every unlisted IP is blocked. Must be true.

applicationKeys.description: Application keys to scope this allowlist entry to.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

environment.description: Deployment environment scope: production, staging, preview, local, test, or all. Default for investigations is production.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

name: securenow_allowlist_add
title: Add Restrictive Allowlist IP
